The Ghana Stock Exchange (GSE) has appointed Kojo Darpaah, CFA, as Head of the Ghana Fixed Income Market (GFIM), effective November 30, 2026.
Kojo joins the GSE from Fidelity Bank Ghana, where he served as Director, Financial and Capital Markets with responsibility for the bank's foreign exchange, fixed income, and capital markets businesses.
He brings over 15 years of experience spanning treasury and financial markets, investment banking, and corporate governance.
He began his career at CalBank and has since held progressively senior leadership positions across Ghana’s banking sector, including roles at Barclays Bank Ghana, First National Bank Ghana, UMB, and Fidelity Bank Ghana.
His career has encompassed trading, treasury management and strategic leadership, positioning him as a financial market professional with deep expertise in market development and institutional growth.
He has worked extensively with regulators, local and offshore institutional investors, and development finance institutions, and was an inaugural member of the National Technical Committee that developed the operational framework for the GFIM.
He holds an MSc in Financial Engineering from Claremont Graduate University, USA, and is a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) holder. He served as an Independent Non-Executive Board Member and Board Treasurer of Fairtrade Africa and as Chair of the Advocacy, Research and Standards Committee of CFA Society Ghana.
In his new role, Mr. Darpaah will oversee and manage all activities of the GFIM and lead the development and implementation of strategic initiatives to enhance the growth, efficiency, and competitiveness of the fixed income market, including its expansion to corporate issuers.
His appointment further strengthens the GSE's commitment to advancing the Ghana Fixed Income Market and supporting the growth, depth, and efficiency of Ghana's capital market.
